Good to know

Questions

Can I swap a flower if it is unavailable?

Yes. We will message you before substituting and suggest a similar stem.

How do I pay?

After you send your pre-order we confirm the details on WhatsApp and share payment instructions.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Changes are free up to 48 hours before your date. Please message us as early as you can.

How long will the bouquet last?

Our flowers are artificial, so they do not wilt and need no water. Keep them out of direct sun and dust them gently to keep the colors bright.

Can you add a card message?

Yes. Write it in the notes field and we will include a handwritten card.
